text: Apples are healthy fruits. Eating apples every day keeps you energized. Fresh apple juice is refreshing.
Bananas are yellow fruits. Eating a banana is a quick snack. Banana smoothies are popular.
Oranges are citrus fruits rich in vitamin C. Orange juice is a common breakfast drink.
Dogs are loyal animals. Puppies are adorable pets. Taking care of a dog teaches responsibility.
Cats are independent animals. Kittens are playful and cute. Many people have cats as pets.
Kittens are playful baby cats. They are very cute and fun to play with.
Bookstores sell novels, textbooks, and magazines. Customers love browsing books. Reading books improves knowledge.
Elephants are the largest land animals. Wildlife safaris often include elephants. Conservation of elephants is important.
Modern office buildings feature innovative architecture. Architecture influences urban design. Skyscrapers are examples of office architecture.
The newspaper provides daily news. Media outlets report politics, sports, and culture. The press informs people about events.
